text: Handling deadlines well depends on four key skills. First, good time management helps you plan your work and avoid last-minute stress. Second, prioritization means deciding which tasks are most important, so you focus on them first. Third, scope management is about being realistic and not taking on more than you can finish. Finally, communication is essential: if a deadline is at risk, tell your team or manager early instead of waiting until it is too late. When you combine these four skills, you can meet deadlines more calmly and build trust with the people you work with.
